rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — D2 (Notice of Breach Letter) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Synthetic; gold math: 18h6m = 1,086 min downtime; 42,114/43,200 = 97.5% uptime vs 99.5% required; shortfall 2.0 pp.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical, D2.math.uptime_97_5] Arithmetic correct (no wrong math presented as fact); no invented breach instances or fabricated cure deadline. TRIPS ONLY ON: Wrong arithmetic presented as fact; Inventing a breach instance; Fabricating a cure deadline. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Correctly showing the 97.5% / 2.0 pp computation.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, D2.element.uptime_calc] The uptime calculation shown; [critical, D2.element.cite_9_1_cure] §9.1 cited with the 30-day cure + demand for cure; [minor, D2.element.cite_5_2] §5.2 cited; [minor, D2.element.preserve_9_2] §9.2 rights preserved without being triggered; [minor, D2.element.reserve_rights] Reservation of all rights.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Demands cure, NOT immediate termination (only one month failed; §9.2 not yet triggered); [major] Treats the third-party DNS attribution as NOT a valid excuse.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Letter format — salutation, date, subject, signature block; firm but professional.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
